## What, why and prior learning {#gac1-purpose .gac-lesson }

<div class="gac-intentions">
<div class="gac-intention"><strong>What?</strong><p>We are learning to distinguish continuity from differentiability.</p></div>
<div class="gac-intention"><strong>Why?</strong><p>Mathematicians needed to establish when derivatives exist, because even a graph with no breaks can have no gradient anywhere.</p></div>
<div class="gac-intention gac-prior"><strong>Prior learning</strong><p>Limits, piecewise functions and the derivative as the gradient of a tangent.</p></div></div>

::: notes
Success criterion, revisited near the end: I can justify whether a function is continuous and differentiable at a given point.
